Configure a clutch for rendering

Source: R/incubate.R
incubate.Rd

Sets rendering options on a breed()ed clutch. Returns the clutch with those options stored on it; calls are additive, so options layer the way ggplot2's + does:

Usage

incubate(
  x,
  palettes = NULL,
  lower_palette = NULL,
  scale = NULL,
  split = NULL,
  legend_position = NULL,
  legend_orientation = NULL,
  show_values = NULL,
  value_size = NULL,
  grid_colour = NULL,
  grid_linewidth = NULL,
  cell_inset = NULL,
  na_colour = NULL,
  row_order = NULL,
  col_order = NULL,
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  caption = NULL,
  show_key = NULL,
  upper_name = NULL,
  lower_name = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A clutch from breed().

palettes

A palettes() object, or a character vector of upper colours (paired with lower_palette).

lower_palette

Optional companion to a bare palettes vector.

scale

"separate" or "shared". Whether upper / lower triangles share a single value range.

split

"down" or "up". Diagonal direction.

legend_position

"right", "bottom", or "none".

legend_orientation

"vertical" or "horizontal".

show_values

Logical. Print each value inside its triangle.

value_size

Numeric text size for value labels.

grid_colour

Colour of the grid between triangles / cells.

grid_linewidth

Width of grid lines.

cell_inset

Numeric in [0, 0.5). Shrinks each cell on every side to leave a thin gap between neighbouring cells. Default 0.04. Pass 0 for contiguous cells.

na_colour

Fill for NA cells.

row_order, col_order

Optional character vectors giving manual row / column orders. Must be permutations of the clutch's row / column labels.

xlab, ylab, title

Axis and plot titles.

subtitle, caption

Optional plot subtitle and caption strings.

show_key

Logical. If TRUE (default), inject a split-tile key glyph below the legend colourbars explaining which triangle is which.

upper_name, lower_name

Override the labels stored on the clutch.

Value

The clutch, with the supplied options merged into its config.

Details

breed(a, b) |>
  incubate(scale = "shared") |>
  incubate(split = "up")

produces a clutch with both scale = "shared" and split = "up". Pass NULL to leave an option at its rendering default; the function only records arguments you explicitly set.

All arguments other than x are optional. Values are validated at render time so that incremental incubate() calls don't reject otherwise-fine partial configurations.

See also

breed(), plot.clutch()

Examples

set.seed(1)
u <- matrix(runif(20), 4, 5)
l <- matrix(runif(20), 4, 5)
breed(u, l) |>
  incubate(scale = "shared", split = "up") |>
  plot()
